result.instructions: Tools for Vital, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show sleep from the last seven days for the first user in my account."; "Show workouts from the past two weeks for the first user in my account."; "Which wearables or fitness apps has the first user in my account connected?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Vital data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run vital_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run vital_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run vital_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. vital_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: vital_get_timeseries
tools.title: Get timeseries data
tools.description: Get timeseries data points for a user and resource over a date range. Supported resources: heartrate, hrv, glucose, blood_pressure, blood_oxygen, steps, respiratory_rate, body_weight, body_fat, distance, water, vo2_max, stress_level, mindfulness_minutes, calories_active, calories_basal, floors_climbed, caffeine, cholesterol. Vital API: GET /v2/timeseries/{user_id}/{resource}.

end_date.description: End date yyyy-mm-dd (inclusive). Defaults to today upstream.

provider.description: Filter to a single provider slug (e.g. oura, fitbit).

tools.name: vital_create_user
tools.title: Create user
tools.description: Creates a Vital user record (additive). Returns the Vital user_id. Vital API: POST /v2/user.

client_user_id.description: Your own stable id for the user (required).

fallback_time_zone.description: IANA time zone used if the provider doesn't report one.

ingestion_start.description: Earliest date to ingest data from (yyyy-mm-dd).

ingestion_end.description: Latest date to ingest data to (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: vital_create_link_token
tools.title: Create link token
tools.description: Creates a short-lived Link token to connect a user's wearable/provider (no health data is modified). Vital API: POST /v2/link/token.

user_id.description: The Vital user id to create the link token for (required).

provider.description: Pre-select a single provider slug to connect.

redirect_url.description: URL to redirect to after the connection flow.

filter_on_providers.description: Restrict the connectable providers to this list of slugs.
